messages:
Alice: Quick sync — Q2 ask from a large customer: they want a 6mo pining window for any onboarded model + a clear migration gracepath. Can we triage what this means for catalog onboarding?
Ben: Curious on scope — is this for *all* new models or specific cohorts?
Sam: It's for their critical customer journey only (text-gen endpoints). They'll accept a canary + staged migration but need guarantees.
Priya: From an eval perspective we need: relative quality delta <= 3% on our standard eval set, p95 latency change < 20ms, and determinism checks for tool-calls.
Dan: Sales says they will sign for Dedicated if we commit to the 6mo pin + documented rollback plan. This is time-sensitive.
Emily: Operational constraint — keeping pinned model binaries around increases storage and long-tail infra churn. Need to quantify storage and instance-mapping cost.
Ben: Implementation idea: maintain a pinned pointer + optional compatibility shim (model adapter) for 6mo. After that, automatic fallback to the latest minor version unless customer opts out.
Priya: We need benchmarks to gate onboarding — propose a mini-suite: (1) perf harness (latency/throughput), (2) quality evals (our prompt battery), (3) deterministic tool-call tests. Pass = onboarding green.
Alice: OK — sounds like two things: product promise (6mo pin + migration gracepath) and technical guardrails (benchmarks + storage/cost plan).
Sam: Customer also asked for communication cadence: 30/15/7 day notices, and a pre-migration canary with their PD contact.
Ben: For the runtime, can we support dual-serving (old pinned + new canary) for a short overlap window? That impacts autoscaler and routing.
Emily: Dual-serving is doable but will need a canary capacity reserve flag on Dedicated, otherwise noisy autoscaling could push latency. Estimate: +1 GPU per heavy model for overlap.
Priya: On quality thresholds — propose we compute relative Rouge/BLEU-like metrics and an embedding-based semantic drift score. If drift > X, block migration. Also run a small human eval for high-risk customers.
Dan: From contract side we should offer a paid extended pin (beyond 6mo) as an add-on. For now lock the 6mo in the template.
Alice: Action items: I'll draft the product promise text and the comm cadence. Ben: produce a runtime feasibility doc with cost delta. Priya: sketch the benchmark suite and gate thresholds. Emily: cost + capacity numbers. Sam: confirm customer acceptance criteria and PD contacts.
Ben: Quick question — do we want to allow pinning to a quantized variant? Might save infra but could change quality.
Priya: Allow quantized pinned variants only if they pass the same quality gates and we include an explicit compatibility note in onboarding docs.
Alice: Good call. We'll loop in Legal for contract language. Can we try to have a PR with the minimum spec by EOD Thursday? :eyes:
Sam: I'll coordinate with the customer for canary dates.
Emily: I'll attach a rough infra delta in the runtime doc.
deploy-bot: New ticket created: PROD-1298 "6mo-pin product promise + migration playbook" — assignees: Alice, Ben, Priya, Emily, Sam.
Alice: Thanks — short triage meeting Thu 10:15am?
Dan: Works for me.
Priya: Works.
Ben: On calendar.
Alice: Perfect. We'll iterate the spec in the ticket.
